column1: # Greenhouse Ventilation Controller — Custom Partition Table
#   0x9000–0x1DFFF  NVS   — config namespaces + event-log ring buffer (84 KB)
#   0x1E000–0x1FFFF OTA data — active/inactive bank metadata (8 KB)
#   0x20000–0x21FFFF  app0 / Bank A — firmware image slot A (2 MB)
#   0x220000–0x41FFFF app1 / Bank B — firmware image slot B (2 MB)
#   0x420000–0x51FFFF lfs0 / LittleFS A — web assets paired with Bank A (1 MB)
#   0x520000–0x61FFFF lfs1 / LittleFS B — web assets paired with Bank B (1 MB)
#   Active firmware bank A → mount lfs0;  active firmware bank B → mount lfs1.
#   T13 (OTA) enforces this coupling; T11 (Web Server) always mounts the active
#   The ESP-IDF partition table has no dedicated "littlefs" subtype.
#   Both lfs0 and lfs1 use subtype "spiffs"; the LittleFS library identifies
